point_entries_sign_check.name: point_entries_sign_check
point_entries_sign_check.value: "point_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is not null or ("point_entries"."kind" = 'violation' and "point_entries"."points" < 0) or ("point_entries"."kind" = 'achievement' and "point_entries"."points" > 0)

point_rules_points_check.name: point_rules_points_check
point_rules_points_check.value: ("point_rules"."kind" = 'violation' and "point_rules"."points" between -100 and -1) or ("point_rules"."kind" = 'achievement' and "point_rules"."points" between 1 and 100)

activities_dates_check.name: activities_dates_check
activities_dates_check.value: "activities"."starts_on" is null or "activities"."ends_on" is null or "activities"."starts_on" <= "activities"."ends_on"
